prior_independent_bbo.note: Independent sampled BBO evidence is distinct from same-core raw/journal replay equivalence.

asan_ubsan.scope: Synthetic corruption, exact bytes, framing, lifecycle and checkpoint cases; no full canonical journal sanitizer rerun.

negative_controls: Equal-timestamp adds reordered: final book and full-state hashes equal, intermediate FIFO hashes differ.
CRC-valid incorrect stored SHA-256 rejected by Python; C++ success retains source_identity_verified=false.
Corruption, truncation, repaired outer checksums, non-canonical packing and maximum split-frame carry are exercised.
Missing/anomalous/malformed summaries, nonempty stderr, all-empty checkpoints and input/tool/journal mutation fail.

retention.public_evidence: Aggregate counts, identities, schema, commands and limits only

limits: 27 sampled full-state checkpoints, not every real-day state.
FNV-1a state fingerprints are non-cryptographic and can collide.
Same reconstruction core on both transports; no additional independent depth/FIFO oracle.
Offline observed-wire container, no accepted-mutation encoding or live crash recovery.
No throughput, storage-speed or latency inference from this integrity run.

checks: Stored journal headers/footers and byte formula match the report.
Actual private checkpoint CSVs match reported counts, coverage and SHA-256.
Source, binary, prior report and private harness identities match.
Published evidence contains no per-event rows; data artefacts are Git-ignored.
Documentation scopes and all local Markdown links agree with the evidence.
